manifest.name: dsh-deepseek-status
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a peak/off-peak billing indicator, a live account balance, and a per-conversation cost meter (subagent sessions included) beside the composer — self-updating and credential-free.

scripts.test: node tools/test-data.mjs && node tools/test-cost.mjs && node tools/test-pricing.mjs && node tools/test-cost-client.mjs && node tools/test-balance.mjs && node tools/test-bundle.mjs && node tools/test-install.mjs

bundle.text:
# Inserts the one Loader row this bundle owns.
#
# A package gets exactly one row and exactly one browser module id, so the two
# features share this package and this client bundle; the browser half registers
# each feature's own slot entries.
#
# The row must name the package itself, never a subpath: the browser module id is
# derived from the row specifier by resolving `<specifier>/client`, so a row such
# as `dsh-deepseek-status/host` fails to import when the client half is resolved.

- insert:
    - id: dsh-deepseek-status
      name: 'dsh-deepseek-status'

readme.text:
给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的一个插件：在输入框旁边常驻三个徽标。

- **计费时段**：现在是峰价还是谷价，还有多久切换，当前各模型的价格
- **本对话花费**：这个对话到现在花了多少钱——**所有子代理会话也算进去**；点开看按会话、模型、峰谷的拆分
- **账户余额**：账号里还有多少钱（充值 + 赠送）

数据自动更新，装完不用管。

**桌面版（desktop profile）**：`dsh plugin` 不管这个 profile，命令行会直接停下：

```
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

两条路，任选一条：

- 侧边栏 Plugins → Add plugin，填 `github:XG221B/dsh-deepseek-status`；
- 或者用仓库自带的安装器。它做的是 DSH 自己做的那两步——在 profile 目录里 `pnpm add`，再把真实包名并入 `dsh.profile.bundles`——只是绕开了那句拒绝。需要先克隆本仓库，在仓库目录里运行：

```sh
node tools/install.mjs --profile desktop
```

**其它 profile**（web / tui / headless …）：命令行本来就能用。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:XG221B/dsh-deepseek-status
```

卸载：前者把 `add` 换成 `remove`；安装器加 `--remove`。

`github:` 这类 spec 要经 git 访问 github.com，网络到不了时改用同一个提交的 tarball，两种方式都认：

```sh
node tools/install.mjs --profile desktop \
  --spec https://codeload.github.com/XG221B/dsh-deepseek-status/tar.gz/refs/heads/main
```

装完刷新一次页面；覆盖安装旧版本则要重启一次 Harness（Host 代码缓存在进程里）。

```
● 谷价 · 距峰价 5天15小时        ● 花费 ¥44.09*        ● 余额 ¥110.00
```

点计费徽标：当前时段与下次切换、价格表、一行规则和数据核对时间。
点花费徽标：总额（含子代理合计）、按模型与 token 的金额、未计价提示、数据核对时间。
点余额徽标：充值余额、赠送余额、合计，以及去充值、查看用量两个入口。

两张详情卡都只有几行，展开不会把对话顶高；更细的数字（精确 token 数、节假日与调休规则等）放在 hover 提示里。
带 `*` 表示有调用落在价格表之外的模型上（第三方路由），那部分 token 只列出、不并进总额。
颜色跟随 Harness 主题，中英文跟随界面语言。

- **逐条调用计价**：每条 `assistant/message` 记录的 provider 上报 usage（未命中输入 / 缓存命中 / 输出 / 缓存写入）按**这次调用发生时刻**的峰谷价计费——跨时段、换过模型的会话都不会被一刀切。
- **子代理算在内**：从当前会话日志里的子代理目录递归读取每个子代理会话的日志，它们的花费一并计入，并在详情里以「子代理合计」一行体现。
- **价格表之外的模型**（例如第三方路由提供的模型）单独列出 token 数，明确标为未计价、不并入总额——不给假数字。
- **缓存写入**：官方价格表没有这一项，标为不计费（金额不受影响，token 数照常显示）。
- **没有 usage 记录的内部调用**（例如生成标题、自动压缩的摘要请求）不在日志的计费用量里，因此也不计入。
- 金额由 Host 从**本地会话日志**计算，把每条调用的花费四舍五入到分显示；它是按官方价格表得出的估价，与官方账单口径一致，但不替代账单。

readme.section: 使用前要知道的四件事
readme.text:
**余额需要登录 DeepSeek 账号。** 只用 API key、没登录账号时，Harness 的账号服务里没有钱包，余额徽标就不会显示（计费徽标不受影响，它不需要账号）。

**插件不碰你的密钥。** 余额是向 Harness 自带的账号服务要的，令牌始终留在 Host 进程里，页面只拿到金额数字。余额不写磁盘、不打印、不外发。

**花费只在本机可读。** 花费路由 `/dsh-deepseek-status/cost.json` 从本机会话日志计价，只接受回环地址（`127.0.0.1` / `::1`）；从局域网进来的请求会被拒绝，徽标在这种场景下不显示。这条路由不写盘、不联网，也拿不到你的密钥。

readme.section: 使用前要知道的四件事
readme.text:
**只有计费功能联网。** Host 半边会定时抓官方价格页和节假日数据，做交叉校验后缓存到插件目录下的 `cache/dataset.json`，并在本机回环上开一条只读路由 `/dsh-deepseek-status/data.json` 给页面读。那条路由里只有公开数据；如果你把 Harness 绑到 `0.0.0.0`，同网段的人也能读到它（花费路由不受影响，仍只限回环）。

余额相关的读取最快每分钟一次（页面切到后台就暂停），花费徽标每 20 秒刷新一次，计费数据每 6 小时刷新一次。

**花费徽标需要重启一次 Harness 才会出现。** Host 代码在进程里缓存，覆盖安装后刷新页面只更新浏览器半边；Host 半边要等下次启动。启动后点徽标即可展开明细；若 Host 还没有价格数据或会话持久化，徽标会先隐藏而不是显示猜出来的数字。

```sh
node tools/test-data.mjs         # 数据层解析与校验（100）
node tools/test-pricing.mjs      # 计费逻辑（85）
node tools/test-cost.mjs         # Host 花费引擎（196）
node tools/test-balance.mjs      # 余额逻辑（54）

共 710 项检查；除最后一套（需要联网）外都离线，push 时自动跑。架构说明见 [DEVELOPING.md](./DEVELOPING.md)。

DSH 升级后先跑一次契约检查，再决定要不要重启（一个入口没激活会让界面起不来，这条命令能提前发现）：

```sh
node tools/preflight.mjs --live
```

它静态核对 21 处契约（槽位、客户端服务、标准槽位 props、Host 路由、会话持久化读取 API、用量与子代理目录的事件形状、Cordis 注入语义……）加 1 项信息性检查；`--live` 还会请求运行中的数据集路由与花费路由。
真出问题时，把 `dsh-deepseek-status` 从 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉再启动即可恢复。

计费规则和价格取 [DeepSeek 官方文档](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)；节假日取 [holiday-cn](https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn) 与 [chinese-days](https://github.com/vsme/chinese-days)（都是 MIT），两者必须一致才采用。花费用量取自 Harness 自己的会话日志（`~/.dsh/sessions`），不额外记录任何东西。

在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上开发验证，`2.1.0` 的契约检查在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上通过。
[MIT](./LICENSE)

A plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that keeps three badges beside the composer:

- **Billing window** — peak or off-peak right now, when it switches, and the current rates
- **Conversation cost** — what this conversation has cost so far, **subagent sessions included**; click for a per-session, per-model and per-window breakdown
- **Account balance** — how much is left (topped up plus granted credit)
All three update on their own; there is nothing to maintain.

**Desktop app (the `desktop` profile):** `dsh plugin` refuses to manage that profile and stops with

```
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

Either path works:

- paste `github:XG221B/dsh-deepseek-status` into Plugins → Add plugin in the sidebar; or
- use the installer this repository ships. It performs the same two steps DSH performs — `pnpm add` in the profile directory, then registering the true package name in `dsh.profile.bundles` — without tripping that refusal. Clone this repository first and run it from inside:

```sh
node tools/install.mjs --profile desktop
```

**Every other profile** (web / tui / headless …) already has a command line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:XG221B/dsh-deepseek-status
```

Uninstall with `remove` instead of `add`, or `--remove` for the installer.

A `github:` spec reaches github.com through git; when that is unreachable, use a tarball of the same commit — both accept one:

```sh
node tools/install.mjs --profile desktop \
  --spec https://codeload.github.com/XG221B/dsh-deepseek-status/tar.gz/refs/heads/main
```
Refresh the page once afterwards; replacing an installed version needs one Harness restart (Host code is cached in the process).

```
● Off-peak · peak in 5d 15h        ● Cost ¥44.09*        ● Balance ¥110.00
```

Click the pricing badge for the current window and next switch, the rate table, a one-line rule, and when the rates were checked. Click the cost badge for the total (with the subagent subtotal), the money per model and its token counts, an unpriced warning, and when the session data was folded. Click the balance badge for topped-up / granted / total, plus links to top up and review usage.

Both detail cards are only a few lines tall, so opening one never pushes the conversation up; finer numbers (exact token counts, holiday/make-up-day rules) live in hover titles.
A `*` means some calls ran on a model outside the rate table (a third-party route); those tokens are listed but never folded into the total. Colours follow the Harness theme, text follows the UI language.

- **Every call is priced at its own instant**: each `assistant/message` record carries the provider-reported usage (uncached input / cache read / output / cache write) and the event time decides which published column—peak or off-peak—applies. A conversation crossing a window boundary or switching models is never flattened to one rate.
- **Subagents count**: local subagent sessions are discovered from the parent log's catalog and their logs are read recursively; their cost is part of the total and shown as one subagent subtotal line.
- **Models without a rate row** (third-party routes) are reported separately as unpriced tokens, excluded from the total—never a made-up number.
- **Cache writes** have no row in the published table, so they are labelled not billed (tokens still shown, amount unaffected).
- **Internal calls that log no usage** (session-title generation, compaction summaries) are not part of the logged billed usage and are therefore not counted.
- The Host prices the **local session logs**; each call's amount is rounded to the cent for display. This is an estimate from the published rates: same usage source as the bill, but not a replacement for it.

**The balance needs a DeepSeek account sign-in.** With API-key-only setup the account service has no wallet to report, so the balance badge simply does not appear. The pricing and cost badges are unaffected.

**The plugin never touches your key.** The balance is read from Harness's own account service; the token stays in the Host process and the page only receives the numbers. Nothing about the balance is written to disk, logged, or sent anywhere.

**Cost is readable only on this machine.** The cost route `/dsh-deepseek-status/cost.json` prices the local session log and answers loopback callers only (`127.0.0.1` / `::1`); requests arriving from the network are refused and the badge stays hidden there. That route writes nothing, goes online for nothing, and never sees your key.

**Only the pricing feature goes online.** The Host half periodically fetches the official pricing pages and holiday data, cross-checks them, caches the result in `cache/dataset.json` inside the plugin directory, and serves one read-only loopback route — `/dsh-deepseek-status/data.json` — to the page. That route only carries public data; if you deliberately bind Harness to `0.0.0.0`, others on your network can read it too (the cost route stays loopback-only).
The balance is read at most once a minute (polling pauses while the page is in the background), the cost badge refreshes every 20 seconds, and pricing data refreshes every six hours.

**The cost badge needs one Harness restart.** Host code is cached in the process, so after an over-the-top install a page refresh only updates the browser half; the Host half waits for the next start. After that, clicking the badge opens the breakdown. When the Host has no pricing data or no session persistence yet, the badge hides itself instead of showing a guessed number.

```sh
node tools/test-data.mjs         # data layer parsing and validation (100)
node tools/test-pricing.mjs      # pricing logic (85)
node tools/test-cost.mjs         # Host cost engine (196)
node tools/test-balance.mjs      # balance logic (54)

710 checks in total; everything except the last suite (which needs network) is offline and runs on every push. Architecture notes: [DEVELOPING.md](./DEVELOPING.md).

After a Harness update, run the contract check before restarting:

```sh
node tools/preflight.mjs --live
```

It statically verifies 21 contracts (slots, client services, standard slot props, the Host route API, the session-persistence read API, the logged usage and subagent-catalog event shapes, Cordis injection semantics, …) plus one informational check, and `--live` also probes the running dataset and cost routes.

One inactive entry fails the whole desktop web boot, and this catches that in advance. If something does break, remove `dsh-deepseek-status` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` and start again.

Rates and the billing rule come from the [official DeepSeek docs](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing); holidays come from [holiday-cn](https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn) and [chinese-days](https://github.com/vsme/chinese-days) (both MIT) and are used only when the two agree. Cost usage comes from Harness's own session logs (`~/.dsh/sessions`); the plugin records nothing extra.
Developed and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`; the `2.1.0` contract check passes against `0.2.1-rc.2`.
[MIT](./LICENSE)
